title: docs(releases): the 18.0.0 notes and upgrade checklist, walked from 17.7.0; Upgrading's table gains 18.0.0 and 17.5–17.7
body:
Fixes #24905
Clause-②: no

The v18 line gets its curated 18.0.0 page, `content/docs/releases/v18/18-0.mdx`, beside `index.mdx` as the v17 line does it, with a `## Upgrade checklist` walked from 17.7.0 on the published 18.0.0 packages. `index.mdx` drops the "curated notes … are not written yet" sentence and links the page; `meta.json` lists it. Upgrading's per-release table gains a v18.0.0 row and the 17.5.0, 17.6.0 and 17.7.0 rows, and its stale v17.4.0 row now links the checklist `17-4.mdx` carries. The first downstream reader is objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2202 (HotCRM's upgrade to 18.0.0); this PR does not claim to have walked it.

## The CHANGELOG filter

- **Read.** The `## 18.0.0` sections of every package CHANGELOG at the version commit `06cab4849a`: 53 packages, 1,115 distinct entries (`@objectstack/spec` alone: 341), 340 of them marked BREAKING or carrying a `(narrowing)` Clause-② arm. The 340 were read in body (their FROM → TO tables and one-line fixes); the other 775 were screened by title, and the 253 whose title says refuse / retire / remove / default / rename were read further.
- **Kept: 129 changeset commits cited on the page** (153 of the 1,115 entries; 137 of the 340 flagged).
- **The rule.** An entry is kept when an application must edit something for 18.0.0 (its metadata, its code against the published packages, its REST or SDK client, its tests on `@objectstack/verify`, or its deployment configuration) **and** the change could be measured on the 18.0.0 artifact. Left out: platform internals and tooling, the Console refresh entries, rules that bind only a walled operator, entries a later entry undoes, surfaces that shipped only in a prerelease (`record:json`), and two app-relevant behaviours that could not be measured here (`1b40780` approvals resume as the decider; `f05649f` / `3f0b6f2` hook `readonly` and `onError: 'abort'` rollback).
- **Deviation from the named corpus:** the dispatch named `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md`; it holds 132 of the 340 flagged entries, so the other packages' sections were read too (decided on the business-need axis: the CLI, runtime and plugin breaks an upgrader meets live there).

## Checklist steps, as measured on 18.0.0

| Step | What it says | How it was measured on 18.0.0 |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |

| 1 · migrate meta | read its list as a search list | walk: `406 manual change(s)` on a one-object app |
| 1 · skills | remove the `skills add` skills, add `@objectstack/skills` with the project's manager, sync | walk: `Skipped … installed with skills add` ×10 + `Nothing to sync.` exit 0 before; `Synced 10 skills` after; `npm install --save-dev` exit 1 `edgesOut` in the pnpm project |
| 1 · validate/build | run both | walk: both exit 0 |
| 2 · overlays | `os migrate security-catalog-overlays` before the first boot | walk 2: exit 0, `✓ No environment-wide permission-set or position row is stored over a package-held name` |

| 2 · not apply first | `os migrate apply --allow-destructive` is not the remedy | walk, on a DB copy: `os migrate plan` 28 destructive, apply exit 1 `✗ Refusing to drop sys_comment.reactions …` |

| 2 · serve | the server serves the upgraded DB | walk: admin signs in, keeps `platform_admin` / `admin_full_access`, 3 notes read, a 4th written, the 17.7.0 API key answers 200 |

| 3 · flows | value slots CEL, text slots `{{ }}`, bound roots, `$` names, node contracts, aliases, edges, retry | probes: `os validate` (rule `expression-invalid`, exit 1) and `defineStack` (`STACK_SCHEMA_INVALID` 422) on the installed 18.0.0 spec, each position the tag names |
| 3 · pages, views, actions | props are errors, `dataSource` binding, retired keys, layout, list views, `editInline`, url schemes | probes as above; save door measured: `PUT /api/v1/meta/page/NAME` → `422 INVALID_METADATA` for an undeclared prop and `kind: 'jsx'` |
| 3 · objects, fields | `externalSharingModel`, `unique: true`, `controlled_by_parent`, stage `kind`, one-hop formulas, option `visibleWhen`, metadata-table lookups, duplicates, `defineSeed` | probes (`defineStack`, `os validate`, `defineSeed`) |
| 3 · security | `permissionSets`, retired permission-set keys, `packageId`, `'.FIELD'`, one name per holder, sharing rules, manifest `permissions` | probes; `NAMESPACE_CONFLICT` read off `@objectstack/objectql` `dist/core.js`; declared-rule text read off `@objectstack/plugin-sharing` |
| 3 · datasources, templates, webhooks, inbound hooks | `mongo`, template keys and registry, declared webhooks, timestamped signature | probe + walk (`os serve` with `OS_DATABASE_DRIVER=mongo` exit 1); tarball: `plugin-email`, `DeclaredWebhookNameConflictError` (`plugin-webhooks`), `signature-body-only` (`trigger-api`) |
| 3 · hooks and code | hook-body lowering, engine context, removed exports, `allowEnvironmentOverlay`, hand-built kernels, `os meta resync`, verify | tarball: `cli/dist/utils/extract-hook-body.js`, `plugin-security` (`carries no principal`, `AUTHZ_STORE_IDENTITY_OBJECTS`), `service-i18n` d.ts, `verify`; exports probed absent; walk: `os meta resync` exit 2 `command meta:resync not found` |
| 3 · REST, SDK, keys | key lifecycle, CORS, anonymous docs and i18n, body validation, catalog rows gone, upload scopes, reactions, form submit, imports, search | walk 2 against the served 18.0.0: new key `expires_at` +90 d, 2-year key `400 API_KEY_EXPIRY_TOO_LONG`, 17.x key stamped +1 y; no `access-control-allow-origin` for a foreign origin (GET and preflight); `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` on `/api/v1/openapi.json` and `/api/v1/i18n/locales`; `400 INVALID_REQUEST` for `text/plain`; `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` for `null`, `[1,2]` and `expectedVersion: 3`; 404 on the four catalog objects; grants carry `permission_set`, no `permission_set_id`; `scope: 'public'` → `400 INVALID_REQUEST`; `403` codes, `PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE`, the submit and import doors read off the tarballs |

| 4 · walled postures | `group` / `isolated` boot on a fresh DB with their prerequisites | walk: three refusals in order (organizations runtime, `OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAIL`, membership policy), then `✓ Server is ready` with `Tenancy: group` and `Tenancy: isolated` |
| 5 · tags | `latest` 18.0.0, `next` 18.0.0-next.5 (older), `rc` 17.0.0-rc.6; never `@next` | `npm view … dist-tags` on spec, cli, runtime, core, objectql, skills, organizations, create-objectstack; `npm view … time` / `versions` (no `next.4`) |

## The walk

- **Fixture.** `create-objectstack@17.7.0` blank scaffold (`v17app`, pnpm 10.28, Node 22.22), its ten skills installed by `skills add`, booted once on 17.7.0 with `objectstack start` into `.objectstack/data/objectstack.db`. Walk 1 seeded an admin and three notes; walk 2, on a fresh scaffold that followed the written steps 1 and 2 verbatim, also seeded an API key and a comment carrying a stored emoji reaction. Everything ran under the session scratchpad, never in the repo.
- **Outcomes.** Every step in the table above ran as the page says; walks 1 and 2 printed the same ceremony numbers. Extra measurements: the walled postures on a fresh database, `OS_DATABASE_DRIVER=mongo`, a production boot with no auth secret, and the save door.
- **What the walk changed in the page.**
  1. The skills step: `npm install --save-dev` exits 1 (`npm error Cannot read properties of null (reading 'edgesOut')`) in the pnpm project `create-objectstack` makes, so the page (and `index.mdx`) adds the package with the project's manager.
  2. `specVersion` is a hand edit: `--write` rewrites `engines.protocol` only, and nothing on the boot path reads `specVersion`.
  3. The order in step 2: overlays first, then a boot that is refused on purpose (its schema sync creates the tables the ceremony needs: 77 planned before it, 81 after), and ⛔ not `os migrate apply --allow-destructive`, which the drift lines recommend and which refuses.
  4. The tail of step 2: a served boot still logs three orphaned columns; `comment-reactions` then `apply --allow-destructive` clears them.
  5. Step 4: the "not carried yet" premise split in two once the tarballs were read (below).

## The PM's hypotheses, measured

1. **Falsified.** `walledPostureRefusal` is in `@objectstack/cli@18.0.0-next.5` (`dist/commands/serve.js`) and absent from `@objectstack/cli@18.0.0`; history: added by `ae6bd1a696` (#24480), removed by `fc34d000fc` (#24667). `os serve` 18.0.0 boots `group` and `isolated` once the organizations runtime, the owner email and a membership policy are present; point 4 states that posture with the measured refusals.
2. **Confirmed.** The boot is refused before the port binds, exit 1, by the `com.objectstack.organization-ownership-boot-guard` plugin; the error code is `ORGANIZATION_OWNERSHIP_MIGRATION_REQUIRED` (on the error object, not in the printed line), and the remedy names `os migrate organization-ownership --out PLAN` then `--apply --plan-file PLAN --backup-taken`.
3. **Confirmed.** `17-4.mdx` carries `## Upgrade checklist` (line 606) and `### 17.4.0`; 17.5–17.7 each carry one (lines 1671, 1524, 1259) and had no row.

**The card's own premise, measured** (at `a7199ef974`; 7a-2 has since merged after the cut — see the merge section). "The 18.x steps that landed after the cut (for example 7a-2, PR #24872) ship in 18.1.0" does not hold as written: #24872 is an open PR, not on `main`; and 7a-3 (#24828) and 7b-3 (#24845) landed **before** the version commit, so their code is in the 18.0.0 packages while their changesets are still pending. Step 4 says so.

## Choices settled here

- **The corpus**: all 53 package CHANGELOGs, not spec's alone — the business-need axis (above).
- **Measurement tags per line** (measured in the walk / probed on 18.0.0 / read off the tarball) instead of the v17 pages' single "not exercised" tag — the guard-against-AI-error axis: a reader can tell a run step from a probed refusal, and nothing unmeasured is presented as a step.
- **Two unmeasurable behaviours left out** rather than tagged "not measured" — the dispatch's ruling that every step is measured on the artifact.

## Deviations, named

- **File surface breach: `scripts/docs-audit/handwritten-docs.json`, one line.** `pnpm check:docs-audit-scope` reds when a hand-written page exists that the roster does not list; the line was written by `node scripts/docs-audit/check-audit-scope.mjs --write` (`+1 added, -0 removed`). The dispatch both bounds the surface to `content/docs/releases/v18/**` and `content/docs/upgrading.mdx` and requires the docs gates to stay green; the ruled page shape needs the roster line, so this PR keeps the gate green and names the breach here rather than choosing silently.
- **One sentence of Upgrading's prose changed beside the rows.** "Only the v17 line is broken out per release. Each of its three minors …" is false once the v18.0.0 row links a per-release page (and "three" was already wrong), so it reads "The v17 and v18 lines are broken out per release. Each v17 minor …". The page's rules are untouched; Upgrading's step-4 skills command is untouched (see the acceptance notes).

## Acceptance notes

- **18.0.0's CHANGELOG omits eight changesets whose code shipped in 18.0.0.** *(Downgraded after the epic seat's note `6294471945`: the #23818 ruling's `annotate-shipped` step carries such entries into the next CHANGELOG with a "Shipped in …" lead line — the 18.0.0 CHANGELOG already holds entries headed `**Shipped in 18.0.0-next.2**, whose CHANGELOG missed this entry` — so this is the release lane working as ruled, not a defect.)* At `a7199ef974`, `.changeset/24583-7a3-…`, `24583-7b3-…`, `24750-…`, `24751-…`, `24767-…`, `24772-…`, `24773-…` and `24785-…` belong to commits that are ancestors of the version commit `06cab4849a`, and the 18.0.0 tarballs carry their code (`deploymentWide`, the no-auth-secret refusal measured with `os serve`, `codeInviteRoleNotFound`); their entries will first appear in 18.1.0's CHANGELOG. Reported to the PM for filing.
- **Before the ceremony, the `[schema-drift]` lines and `os migrate plan` prescribe `os migrate apply --allow-destructive` for the `organization_id` columns without naming the ceremony** (28 destructive changes on the walk's database), and that apply then refuses on `sys_comment.reactions`. Reported to the PM for filing.
- **`npm install --save-dev "@objectstack/skills@…"` fails in a pnpm-installed project** and is still the command in `content/docs/upgrading.mdx` step 4, `content/docs/ai/skills.mdx`, `content/docs/ai/skills-reference.mdx`, `skills/README.md` and `skills/objectstack-upgrade/SKILL.md`. Reported to the PM for filing.
- `18.0.0-next.4` was never published, while every CHANGELOG carries a `## 18.0.0-next.4` section. Observation only.
- `os migrate security-catalog-overlays`'s preview printed "Raw execute() called … FORWARDED, not refused — if it wrote, this boot wrote"; the database file's mtime did not move. Observation only.

## Merge with #24912

#24912 (card #24904, `71696121a6`) edited `content/docs/upgrading.mdx` and `content/docs/releases/v18/index.mdx` and amended `packages/cli/CHANGELOG.md` in place. `git merge origin/main` (no rebase, no force) stopped on one conflict: both sides added a `v18.0.0` row to Upgrading's "Per-release specifics" table, and #24912's side still carried the stale `v17.4.0 — ⛔ checklist not written` row. Resolution: **one `v18.0.0` row** linking `/docs/releases/v18/18-0#upgrade-checklist`, `#upgrading-to-180` and `/docs/releases/v18`, and this PR's 17.4–17.7 rows. `index.mdx` merged clean; `packages/cli/CHANGELOG.md` is #24912's and untouched here. Merge commit `b6917f0b72`; `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main HEAD` exit 0 before the push and again after it (main `71696121a6`).

New measurements for the reconciliation (all on npm 18.0.0, under the session scratchpad):
- **Walk 3, walled:** a `create-objectstack@17.7.0` app with `@objectstack/organizations@17.7.0`, booted under `OS_TENANCY_POSTURE=group`, an owner and two records, moved to 18.0.0 (the exact `"17.7.0"` organizations pin moved by hand): `os migrate security-catalog-overlays` exit 0; refused boot exit 1; plan `posture group`, 81 tables, `unattributableRows: 0`; apply `✓ The ceremony is complete`; served `Tenancy: group`, both records in their organization.
- **Walk 3, development database:** a 17.7.0 `os dev` database moved to 18.0.0. `OS_DATABASE_URL=file:… os serve --dev` exit 1 naming `Run 'os migrate organization-ownership --dev --out PLAN' …`. `os dev` with the artifact 17.7.0's `os start` had compiled still in `dist/`: `✗ The upgrade plan was refused, and nothing was changed.` (the plan refused protocol `^17` although `objectstack.config.ts` read `'^18'`). After `os build`: `✓ Upgraded the development database to the v18 organization ownership` and `✓ server started on the upgraded database`.
- **`os start` with no secret:** a fresh `--home`, no `AUTH_SECRET` / `OS_AUTH_SECRET`: it wrote `HOME/auth-secret` (mode `0600`), served, sign-up `200`.
- **The CHANGELOG copies:** the `@objectstack/cli@18.0.0` tarball's `CHANGELOG.md` line 162 still reads `ae6bd1a: feat(cli)!: 18.0 supports fresh 'single' installs only — …`; the repository's `packages/cli/CHANGELOG.md` at `71696121a6` line 162 reads `ae6bd1a: feat(cli)!: the 18.0 pre-release refusals of … both lifted in 18.0.0`, and its `fc34d00` headline adds "and on databases the ownership ceremony upgraded".

## Round 3

Two sites told a reader to run a destructive apply without reading its plan first; `os migrate apply --allow-destructive` applies **every** destructive change in the plan, and `--yes` skipped its confirmation.

- **Measured on 18.0.0 first** (on a copy of the `group` walk's post-ceremony database): `os migrate plan` listed 4 destructive changes (`sys_comment.reactions`, `sys_sso_provider.created_by` / `updated_by`, index `idx_sys_sso_provider_organization_id`). `os migrate comment-reactions --apply` without `--yes`, non-TTY: exit 1, `⚠ Apply mode writes sys_comment_reaction rows. Re-run with --yes to confirm …`. `os migrate apply --allow-destructive` without `--yes`, non-TTY (stdin `/dev/null`): applied nothing, printed `⚠ Confirmation required. Re-run with --yes to apply, or use "os migrate plan" to preview.`, **exit 0** (the plan still listed 4). On a TTY (a pty): it listed the changes and asked `Apply 4 change(s) to DATABASE? [y/N]`; `n` → `ℹ Aborted — no changes made.` exit 0 (plan still 4); `y` → `✓ Applied 4 change(s).` exit 0, then `✓ Physical schema is in sync with metadata`.
- **`content/docs/upgrading.mdx`, "Upgrading to 18.0" step 8:** "`os migrate comment-reactions --apply --yes`, then `os migrate apply --allow-destructive --yes`" → preview `os migrate comment-reactions`, then `--apply --yes`; run `os migrate plan` and check its destructive entries are only the ceremony's leftovers (in the walk: the three columns); any other entry is the app's own and decided separately; then `os migrate apply --allow-destructive` in a terminal, answering its `[y/N]` prompt after reading the list; in a non-interactive shell it applies nothing and still exits `0`.
- **`content/docs/releases/v18/18-0.mdx`, step 2 "Then clear the drift …":** "then `os migrate apply --allow-destructive --yes`, which dropped the three columns" → the same plan check, the `[y/N]` prompt and the non-TTY behaviour, each quoted from the measurement; the walk's own `--yes` run stays recorded as a fact of the walk; the `group` walk's extra index entry is named.
- **Rule 4 sweep, found and fixed the same way:** `npx skills remove --all` (`-y` implied, removes every installed skill) in `upgrading.mdx` step 4 and `v18/index.mdx` → "run `npx skills list` first", and `18-0.mdx` step 1 names `npx skills list` before the named `skills remove … -y` (measured: it listed the ten `objectstack-*` skills with their source). **Reviewed, not changed:** the ceremony's `--apply --plan-file … --backup-taken` (ruled out of scope); `os migrate security-catalog-overlays` (its bare run is the preview, `--apply` follows it); `os migrate comment-reactions --apply --yes` in `18-0.mdx` (already after its preview); `os migrate meta --from 17 --write` (writes only the source edits it can prove, re-runs the chain and restores on a mismatch; not destructive); `skills experimental_sync --copy -y` (copies the package's skills into the agent directory, skipping `skills add` ones); Upgrading's `os migrate apply --allow-destructive   # … once you have read the plan` (already after `os migrate plan`).

## Gates

At head `9da4c8d328` (merge base `71696121a6`), the re-derived list (62 commands, the same 62 as rounds 1 and 2) ran locally, every one exit 0, after `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/lint...' --filter '@objectstack/client-react...' build` under the verify lock (VERDICT command-exit 0); `--ran` with recorded exit codes: `62 derived, 62 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`. `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main HEAD` exit 0 just before the push. Earlier heads `5019f5152f` and `b6917f0b72` were green on the same 62. CI's own check-runs are the record for everything outside that list.

**Changeset:** none. Measured: all 73 published `package.json` manifests declare `files[]` (control: all 73 name `dist`), none names `content/`, a docs path or `scripts/`, and the root package is private, so `skip-changeset`.
